Margareten (05. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Margareten does not have a documented no-go reputation or a recurring crime hotspot in current press, and general district crime counts (2,049 offences in the first half of 2021, per a parliamentary crime-statistics response) place it in the middle of Vienna's 23 districts rather than among the worst. Reinprechtsdorfer Straße, near the district's western Gürtel-adjacent edge, was the site of two isolated but serious incidents covered by ORF Wien and meinbezirk.at: an armed robbery of an electronics shop (October 2022) and a fatal stabbing followed by a WEGA tactical-unit arrest (reported January/February 2023). In 2023, local politicians debated opening a third police station in that same western part of the district to address 'subjective' safety concerns, while opponents pointed to falling city-wide crime and street-racing on the Gürtel as the area's more persistent nuisance. These are isolated incidents rather than an ongoing pattern, so day is rated green, with night nudged to yellow to reflect the documented serious incidents on Reinprechtsdorfer Straße and Gürtel-edge nuisance activity. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, February 2023; ORF Wien, October 2022; meinbezirk.at, April 2023.
